about: Sitting 4, fifth go, written by hand on 7 Oct 2026. The fourth go's four pictures all came back with the old door positions: the editor copies the layout of any picture of the corridor it is given, whatever the words say (a 'laid out again' prompt with the corridor as picture 1 copied it too). So this go gives it NO picture of the corridor: only a swatch (one door with its wall and floor) for the materials, and composes the corridor from words, looking straight down its middle, three evenly spaced doors a side. The result is a new composition and is laid out afresh. LESSON: to change a layout, do not hand the editor the old layout.
